answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the signal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on cryptographic challenge-response handshakes bound to transient execution receipts. Written in a formal academic rhythm, balance of technical clauses and empirical references register, it stays short. The quill holds work receipts rather than names, so the sparrow of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
